description: Prefill the Notification Popup Animation Maker: a phone-style notification that slides in, holds and slides out, with your own title and message. Returns a link that opens the Tool with these options; the user presses Export there to download the video. All options are optional. Icons and images that need a file upload are not supported.

accent.description: Accent color of the icon tile. Default: "#2563eb".

app.description: App name shown in the notification header. Default: "Messages".

font.description: Font id of the text. Default: "inter".

hold.description: Seconds the notification stays on screen. Default: 3.

icon.description: Icon tile: one emoji or letter, or a library id such as "symbol:bell" or "brand:whatsapp". Uploaded images are not supported. Default: "symbol:message-square".

lead.description: Seconds of empty frame before the notification slides in. Default: 0.5.

look.description: Light or dark notification style. Default: "light".

msg.description: Notification message line. Default: "Hey! Are we still on for tonight?".

scale.description: Size of the notification relative to the frame. Default: 100.

tail.description: Seconds of empty frame after the notification leaves. Default: 0.5.

time.description: Time label shown in the notification, such as "now". Default: "now".

name: create_notification_popup_animation
title: Notification Popup Animation Maker
